svg.title: N0zoM1z0 · Contribution Arcade · 02 / GROWING SNAKE
svg.desc: 13,951 GitHub contributions across 138 active days, 2025-10-12 to 2026-10-14. A growing snake starts with 4 segments and adds one segment for every active date it eats, finishing with 142. All 138 active dates are eaten without self-collision.
